jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Office Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will turn the Munich office into a place where the whole team can do its best work. About the role This is an on-site role at the Filics office in Munich, where engineering, assembly and the rest of the team work side by side. The office is where the whole Filics team comes together. As the company grows, it needs someone who makes it run smoothly every day and shapes it into a place people enjoy working in. You'll own the office fully: you set up the routines, plan the improvements and make sure everything just works. You report to the VP Operations, work closely with HR, and are the first point of contact for the team, visitors and service providers. Und wie kann künstliche Intelligenz dabei helfen, bessere Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen? Mit diesen und vielen weiteren Fragestellungen beschäftigen wir uns bei PILLONG. Dabei setzen wir auf analytische Kompetenz, eigenständiges Denken und die Überzeugung, dass technologische Innovation und menschliche Urteilskraft gemeinsam die Qualität zukünftiger Beratung bestimmen. Wir verstehen Weiterentwicklung nicht nur als Aufgabe gegenüber unseren Mandanten, sondern als eigenen Anspruch.
